decision.reason: the named shared production components do not exist; a monolithic ProductionContractsPage proves reusable SDK and fail-closed states but mixes seven authority cards and mutation forms, while W3-03 to W3-07 runtime contracts remain blocked

committedUiFacts.existingAuthorityPage: ProductionContractsPage lists Brief, EvidenceBundle, EvalContract, ResponsibilityPlan, StageTemplate, ArtifactRelation and ReviewIssue and exposes freeze, compile, resolve and return controls
committedUiFacts.existingTests: page tests cover true empty states, blocked Eval freeze, Stage source blocker and no fake ResponsibilityTemplate
committedUiFacts.impactPreviewReuse: no committed Workshop or web component matching ImpactPreviewDialog was found
committedUiFacts.currentRisk: copying JSX from the monolithic authority page into eight modules would duplicate command readiness, lifecycle labels, focus handling and blocker semantics

componentDecision.ownership: components consume canonical DTOs or read models and emit typed intents only; they never store authority or recompute readiness
componentDecision.composition: one common production-ui package exports pure display primitives plus intent callbacks; Module pages supply exact refs and server commandReadiness
componentDecision.states: loading, empty, partial, stale, blocked, forbidden, unknown, ready and error remain explicit
componentDecision.mutation: buttons emit an intent containing exact refs, expectedVersion and readiness token; page orchestration invokes canonical SDK and refreshes Receipt-backed state
componentDecision.accessibility: stable H1 remains page-owned; component sections use heading hierarchy, status live regions, focusable blocked controls, dialog focus trap and return, and keyboard-operable tabs only where tabs are semantically required
componentDecision.visualBoundary: no static HTML visual draft is changed by W3-09

requiredGreenEvidence: one component implementation and one export identity for all eight Module consumers
strict props from canonical DTOs with unknown enum and malformed ref rejection
no localStorage, mock fallback, duplicated readiness or authority mutation
loading, empty, partial, stale, blocked, forbidden, unknown, ready and error tests
keyboard, focus return, live region, 200 percent zoom and reduced-motion tests
intent emission versus canonical command versus Receipt refresh separation
eight-Module integration matrix without copying component state machines
W3-03 to W3-07 runtime dependencies GREEN before enabling mutation controls

tests.reason: read-only committed component, page, SDK and test inventory only

next: remediate W3-09 plans around one production component package, typed intents and accessibility matrix, then re-review without coding
safety: no source, shared document, static visual, database, tenant, browser or external mutation
